actualOutput.answer: In Australia, Xero supports small businesses by offering tools to automate administrative tasks, manage invoices and quotes, track expenses, connect to bank feeds, and monitor cash flow [E2, E5]. Small businesses can use the mobile app to handle accounting on the go and collaborate online with their accountants or bookkeepers [E2, E4, E5]. For accountants and bookkeepers, Xero provides an integrated practice management solution through the Xero Partner Hub, which allows them to manage clients, staff, and workflows [E4]. The Xero partner program offers professionals free access to accounting software to run their practices, as well as resources for training, marketing support, and the ability to earn discounts on client subscriptions [E1, E3, E4].
